title: Tutorial 11 : Pytorch - Tensors and Data Loaders
channel: NPTEL - Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru
description: Tensors, Operations on Tensors, Data Loaders
instructor: Teaching Assistant / Prof. Prathosh A P

topics.title: Hardware Acceleration & Tensor Creation: From CPU Memory to Accelerator-Ready Tensors
topics.summary: Establishes why deep learning requires hardware accelerators (GPUs) over CPUs due to parallel GEMM core architectures; introduces the PyTorch tensor abstraction, comparing it to NumPy ndarrays, and demonstrates tensor construction from Python lists and NumPy arrays with zero-copy memory semantics.

topics.title: Constructors, Memory Strides & Essential Attributes: Shape, Dtype, and the Device Matching Rule
topics.summary: Details deterministic and stochastic tensor initialization (zeros, ones, rand, and *_like constructors); formalizes the core tensor attributes (shape, dtype=float32, device), and enforces the critical hardware constraint that all binary tensor operands must co-reside on the identical hardware device.

topics.title: Indexing, Multi-Axis Slicing, In-Place Modification & Concatenation Geometry
topics.summary: Examines multidimensional tensor indexing, column and row slicing, and in-place tensor mutations; derives tensor concatenation along batch dimension (dim=0) versus feature dimension (dim=1), highlighting memory contiguity and stride layout.

topics.title: Linear Algebra & Arithmetic Operations: Matrix GEMM (@, matmul), Hadamard Products, and Reductions
topics.summary: Formalizes the three PyTorch matrix multiplication interfaces (@, torch.matmul, and torch.mm with out preallocations), demonstrates element-wise Hadamard multiplication (*, torch.mul) connecting to convolutional sliding dot-products, and details scalar reduction operations (.sum(), .item()).

topics.title: Academic Data Pipelines & Transforms: MNIST Ingestion, Normalization, and Channel Permutations
topics.summary: Contrasts academic benchmark repositories (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST) with commercial dataset requirements; implements torchvision dataset downloading, automated train/test splits, and image transformation pipelines using transforms.ToTensor() for float scaling and channel transposition.

topics.title: Custom Dataset Architecture & DataLoader Integration: The __len__ and __getitem__ Contract
topics.summary: Architects custom PyTorch Dataset classes inheriting from torch.utils.data.Dataset; implements the mandatory structural trinity (__init__, __len__, __getitem__), handles annotation CSV parsing, on-the-fly image decoding and transformations, and demonstrates batch iterator extraction and matplotlib visualization.
